detachments.name: STARSHATTER ARSENAL
detachments.rule_summary: The Necrons possess countless terrifying engines of war. When mustered in great number, these instruments of annihilation sweep across the battlefield, seeking to reclaim lost realms and obliterate any foolish enough to trespass upon the territories of their ancient dynasty. Each time a Necrons model (excluding Monster models) from your army makes an attack that targets a unit within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Hit roll. enhancements.name: DREAD MAJESTY (AURA)
enhancements.description: When this noble unleashes the might of their cosmic armoury, their followers are left in no doubt as to the importance of the battle at hand. If they do not strive to live up to the lethal effectiveness of the dynasty’s war engines, their Overlord’s wrath will be terrible. Overlord Catacomb Command Barge or model only. While a friendly Necrons unit (excluding Monster and Titanic units) is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: MINIATURISED NEBULOSCOPE
enhancements.description: Feeding vampirically on datastreams from the dynasty’s war engines, this device enables its owner to track enemies through multiple dimensions, leaving them no hiding place. Necrons model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the ability. [IGNORES COVER]

enhancements.name: DEMANDING LEADER
enhancements.description: This Necron noble is a master of rapid warfare, commanding armoured columns with great precision. Necrons model only. In your Command phase, select Necrons Vehicle Necrons Mounted one friendly or unit (excluding Titanic units) within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: CHRONO-IMPEDANCE FIELDS
enhancements.description: When activated, this device wreathes dynastic craft in a time-dilation field that reduces the force of incoming blows and shots. Necrons model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted Titanic unit (excluding units) within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in that unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.   CRYPTEK CONCLAVE

stratagems.name: MERCILESS RECLAMATION
stratagems.flavour: The Necrons are driven to reclaim what is theirs, exterminating all who would impede such efforts without mercy.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit (excluding Monster and Titanic units) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: UNYIELDING FORMS
stratagems.flavour: Wrought from living metal and further protected by the arcane technologies of Crypteks, the forms of Necron vehicles and steeds are almost impervious to conventional weapons.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: CHRONOSHIFT
stratagems.flavour: The time‑bending technologies in the nobility’s powerful vehicles allow them to traverse the battlefield in stuttering bursts of hypervelocity.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: DIMENSIONAL TUNNEL
stratagems.flavour: Using phase‑shifting technology, Necron war engines can slip into alternate dimensions, leaving only ghostly traces as they move through solid matter.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move horizontally through models and terrain features.

stratagems.name: ENDLESS SERVITUDE
stratagems.flavour: Should the unclean thralls of lesser species threaten dynastic territories, the fallen Necron soldiery will rise to repel the interlopers.
stratagems.when: End of your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit (excluding Monster and Titanic units) from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.

stratagems.name: REACTIVE REPOSITION
stratagems.flavour: Subroutines buried deep within the neural networks of Necron soldiers and crews enable them to react instantaneously to targeting locks, repositioning themselves to evade incoming fire or close in upo
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit from your army (excluding Monster and Titanic units) that was the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

detachments.name: CRYPTEK CONCLAVE
detachments.rule_summary: Whether building on one anothers’ shared results or vying to produce the most ingenious adaptations, the Crypteks treat the battlefield as an opportunity to test their latest scientific and technological breakthroughs. ■ Ranged weapons equipped by Cryptek models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability. ■ In your Shooting phase, each time Cryptek a unit from your army is selected to shoot, select one of the following abilities: 3+], [ANTI-INFANTRY [ANTI-MOUNTED 4+], [ASSAULT], [HEAVY], [IGNORES

enhancements.name: QUANTUM ABACUS
enhancements.description: This cloud-like familiar of fractal computational electrons possesses a cogitational intellect that, when fed raw data, produces inspired strategic guidance. Necrons model only. Each time you select the bearer’s unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if it is within range of one or more objectives: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: ATOMIC DISINTEGRATORS
enhancements.description: Energy lenses project in a web from a central node borne by the Cryptek, coalescing about Necron weapon systems and focusing their power still further. Cryptek model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment rule, you can also select from the following abilities: [ANTI-MONSTER 5+], [ANTI-VEHICLE 5+].

enhancements.name: GAUNTLET OF COMPRESSION
enhancements.description: Clinging to the bearer’s hand like a glove woven from shadow, this strange device folds space-time with a single gesture, momentarily compressing the relative distance between Necron weapons and their targets. Necrons model only. Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: GRAVITIC BOLAS
enhancements.description: Projected from the bearer’s staff as a secondary energistic emission, these solid-state electroshackles bind and trammel their victims in crackling fetters. Cryptek model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (excluding Titanic units); until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit’s Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.   CURSED LEGION

stratagems.name: MOLECULAR TARGETING
stratagems.flavour: Targeting analysis of the targets’ molecular makeup allows all attempts at shielding or obfuscation to be bypassed with contemptuous ease.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll. If your unit has the Cryptek keyword, you can also ignore any or all modifiers to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: MICROSCARAB SWARM
stratagems.flavour: This thrumming cloud of minute nanoscarabs whirls around the Necrons, affecting instantaneous repairs.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Necron Warriors keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit has the Immortals keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: ANIMUS CURSE
stratagems.flavour: A portion of the Cryptek’s animus clings to the battlefield just long enough to possess their servants and use them to exact revenge.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly Necrons model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: SYNERGISTIC EMPOWERMENT
stratagems.flavour: Quantum reservoirs of potent energies held within this Cryptek’s warrior jewellery release a fragment of their charge to augment nearby Necron forces.
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Necrons model (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 12" of a Cryptek model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that friendly Necrons model has the Cryptek keyword.

stratagems.name: UNTAPPED POWER
stratagems.flavour: Accessing previously undreamed of skeins of cosmic power, the Cryptek unleashes terrible destructive energies onto the battlefield.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Cryptek unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Techno-sorcerous Augmentations Detachment Rule, you can select one additional ability from those available.

stratagems.name: POTENTIALITY SYPHON
stratagems.flavour: Drawing upon the accumulated precausal potential energies that coalesce around significant locations, the conclave are able to steal that power and use it to trigger the unrealized probable remanifest
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a Cryptek unit, it reanimates an additional 1 wound.

detachments.name: CURSED LEGION
detachments.rule_summary: The fury of the Destroyers and – by extension – of the cursed legion is not a wild or reckless thing. It is rather a ruthlessly methodical annihilation of the enemy, in which the Destroyers take the lead while ripples of their strange madness roll out to infect nearby Necrons and goad them, too, to greater efforts of tireless murder. ■ Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by Destroyer Cult models from your army. ■ The first time each turn that a Destroyer Cult unit from your

enhancements.name: DESTROYER ANKH
enhancements.description: Though it resembles a typical ankh, this chest piece fills its host with an insatiable need to exterminate the foe. Catacomb Command Barge Overlord or model only. The bearer has the Destroyer Cult keyword. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit and add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: MURDERMIND
enhancements.description: Consumed by the Destroyer madness, this Cryptek’s powerful intellect is turned entirely toward killing. Cryptek model only. The bearer has the Destroyer Cult keyword and during the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a Destroyer Cult unit (excluding Character units). If you do, the bearer’s unit cannot contain any models Destroyer Cult without the keyword. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of the bearer.

enhancements.name: MARK OF THE NEKROSOR
enhancements.description: The malevolent madness of Ammentar itself burns in the minds of this warrior and their comrades. Destroyer Cult model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: CURSED CIRCLET
enhancements.description: This band of living metal sinks into the bearer’s brow and floods their neural cortex with a murderous urge. Destroyer Cult model only. Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has shot, if any models from the bearer’s unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, the bearer’s unit can make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: the bearer’s unit can be moved a number of inches up to the result, but the bearer’s unit must finish that move as close as possible Aircraft). to the closest enemy unit (excluding When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. A unit cannot make a Surge move while it is Battle-shocked.   PANTHEON OF WOE

stratagems.name: METHODICAL MURDER
stratagems.flavour: In the grip of the Destroyer madness, these Necrons strike and slay with inhuman speed and efficiency.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: IMAGE OF DEATH
stratagems.flavour: Confronted with these android spectres of terminal mortality, even the most courageous enemies find their aim wavering and their limbs shaking.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: MORTIS PROTOCOLS
stratagems.flavour: In the absolute destruction of their enemies, the corrupted Necrons find fresh purpose and a macabre simulacrum of new life.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first time a Destroyer Cult unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.
stratagems.target: One friendly Necrons unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 9" of that Destroyer Cult unit.
stratagems.effect: The friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.

stratagems.name: DRIVEN TO BUTCHERY
stratagems.flavour: The murderous goad of the Destroyer madness pushes these android killers to seemingly impossible efforts to get to grips with the foe.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

stratagems.name: SPREADING MADNESS
stratagems.flavour: It is as though witnessing other Necrons engaged in acts of merciless butchery stokes the Destroyer madness in their fellows.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units, add 2 to the Charge roll.

stratagems.name: UNNATURAL AGGRESSION
stratagems.flavour: The android soldiery of the cursed legion are maddened with the desire to engage and slay their victims at close quarters.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

detachments.name: PANTHEON OF WOE
detachments.rule_summary: The quantum dissonance and molecular erosion caused by multiple C’tan shards in close proximity is enough to fray the very physical being of the foe at an atomic level. Necrons Monster units from your army have the following ability: Distortion Fields (Aura): While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, it is unravelling. While an enemy unit is unravelling, each time an attack targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. At the start of each phase, for

enhancements.name: SINGULARITY MATRIX
enhancements.description: This eldritch device fetters and directs the Deceiver’s powers within a vortex that devours lesser wits entirely. C’tan Shard of the Deceiver model only. This model has the following ability: Lord of Deceit (Aura): Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: QUANTUM GOAD
enhancements.description: The energies of this binding latch onto enemy targets and shunt the shard into alignment with them. C’tan Shard of the Nightbringer model only. This model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: ANIMUS DAMPER
enhancements.description: This device bleeds off the Void Dragon shard’s energies and earths them violently through nearby machines. C’tan Shard of the Void Dragon model only. Once per turn, at the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, select one enemy Vehicle unit visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if that Leadership test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: RELETAVISTIC TETHER
enhancements.description: This binding uses atomic resonance magnetism to compel the shard into the midst of the foe. Transcendent C’tan model only. In your turn, each time this model is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike or Transdimensional Displacement abilities, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. When doing so, if this model is set up within 9" of one or more enemy units, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: DISHARMONISATION CASCADE
stratagems.type: PANTHEON OF WOE – EPIC DEED Stratagem
stratagems.flavour: Tear one shard suddenly from the complex web of atomic resonances and its severing triggers a violent energistic dissonance blast.
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a Necrons Monster model from your army is destroyed, before making its Deadly Demise roll.
stratagems.target: That Necrons Monster model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 3+ instead of on a 6.

stratagems.name: MOLECULAR EROSION
stratagems.type: PANTHEON OF WOE – STRATEGIC PLOY Stratagem
stratagems.flavour: Those without the will to hold themselves together start to physically tatter apart in a molecular haze in the presence of so many god shards.
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons Monster unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one unravelling enemy unit visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from the result. If that test is failed, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.name: MASS TRANSMOGRIFICATION
stratagems.type: PANTHEON OF WOE – EPIC DEED Stratagem
stratagems.flavour: The power of the C’tan rips the foe’s greatest assets apart and forcibly reknits nearby Necron soldiery using the stolen corporeal matter.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Necrons Monster unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: One friendly Necrons unit (excluding Monsters) within 6" of that Monster unit.
stratagems.effect: If that enemy unit was unravelling at the start of the phase, your friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate. RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

stratagems.name: ENTROPHASIC AURA TARGETING
stratagems.type: PANTHEON OF WOE – BATTLE TACTIC Stratagem
stratagems.flavour: Necrons’ android senses can target the foe by reading the exotic radiation signatures wreathed about them by the C’tan shards onslaught.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit (excluding Monsters) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is unravelling, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

stratagems.name: CHRONODISTORTION
stratagems.type: PANTHEON OF WOE – BATTLE TACTIC Stratagem
stratagems.flavour: With the battlefield shuddering in and out of sync with time and space, slain Necrons still strike at their enemies through cracks in temporal causality.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the attacking unit is unravelling: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: PHASE MELDING
stratagems.type: PANTHEON OF WOE – STRATEGIC PLOY Stratagem
stratagems.flavour: The very stuff of reality flows together at an atomic level, and the foe find to their horror that they are literally – and gruesomely – rooted to the spot.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an unravelling enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.target: One Necrons unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
